nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router catch-all API route that wires NextAuth.js GET and POST handlers to the shared authOptions configuration.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Root-level NextAuth configuration file that assembles authOptions by delegating provider and callback selection to the pluggable provider registry, enforcing JWT sessions with a 30-day max age.

nodes.name: cognito.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AWS Cognito authentication provider using next-auth's built-in CognitoProvider, configured from environment variables and sharing OIDC callback logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the shared buildOidcCallbacks factory to avoid duplicating sign-in/JWT/session logic for OIDC-based providers.

nodes.name: credentials.ts
nodes.summary: Implements email/password authentication by querying the users table, comparing bcrypt hashes, and stamping last_login_at; also defines JWT and session callbacks that propagate user id and role into the token.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Provider registry barrel that maps provider IDs to their definitions and exports getAuthProviderDefinition(), which resolves the active provider at runtime from the AUTH_PROVIDER env var.

nodes.name: oidc-callbacks.ts
nodes.summary: Shared OIDC callback factory that handles user upsert on sign-in, DB-backed JWT token stamping, and session surface — reused by both Cognito and generic OIDC providers.
nodes.languageNotes: The same email can exist across multiple providers; the UPSERT uses (email, auth_provider) as the conflict target to keep provider identities distinct.

nodes.name: oidc.ts
nodes.summary: Generic OIDC/OAuth2 provider definition backed by next-auth's KeycloakProvider, supporting any standards-compliant IdP (Okta, Azure AD, Auth0) via OIDC_* env vars and a configurable checks parser.
nodes.languageNotes: Reuses KeycloakProvider internally as a plain OIDC adapter — the provider id and display name are overridden at runtime, making this IdP-agnostic.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AuthProviderDefinition interface that all auth provider modules must satisfy, combining a string id with next-auth providers and callbacks shapes.

nodes.name: getAuthProviderDefinition
nodes.summary: Reads the AUTH_PROVIDER env var, looks up the corresponding provider definition in the registry, and throws a descriptive error if the provider is unknown.

nodes.name: buildOidcCallbacks
nodes.summary: Factory that builds NextAuth callback objects for OIDC providers, handling user upsert on sign-in, last_login_at stamping in the JWT callback, and surfacing the DB user id onto the session; supports per-provider overrides.

nodes.name: parseChecks
nodes.summary: Parses the OIDC_CHECKS environment variable into a validated array of OAuthCheck tokens, filtering out any unrecognized values.
